For each kiosk, get 1 money for every adjacent unique building, special enclosure (occupied or empty), occupied standard enclosure, or pavilion; empty standard enclosures do not count. If multiple players take display cards during income, refill the display after each player. Usually income is simultaneous; if effects require ordering, start with the break initiator (or affected player closest to them) and proceed clockwise.

grades.answer_evidence: At 2 conservation points, choose to upgrade an Action card or activate an additional association worker. At 5 and 8, choose 5 money or the Bonus token by that space (if available). At 10, the first player to reach it makes all players discard one Final Scoring card; if nobody reaches 10 before game end, all discard one before scoring. The game end is checked at the end of your own turn or during a break, when your Appeal and Conservation counters are in the same scoring area or pass one another. Appeal gained during another player's turn waits until your turn ends or a break for this check. The triggering player finishes their turn and everyone else takes one more turn; if triggered during a break, all players take one more turn. Each Final Scoring card can add at most 4 conservation points. Victory Points equal Appeal minus the lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive total wins; ties go to the player who supported the most conservation projects, then tied players share the victory.
